R172.note: Removes the staff-widened queryset so get_queryset matches IsTicketOwner's owner-only contract exactly; no assignment logic existed to preserve.

R173.note: Canonicalizes and checks containment via GetFullPath/GetRelativePath before the read; rooted/other-drive results are also caught by the IsPathRooted check.

R174.note: Correct ODBC positional parameterization; wildcard % kept in the bound value so LIKE behavior is unchanged.

R175.note: ProcessBuilder with an argument array closes shell injection, and the added leading-dash rejection also closes the argument-injection gap without excluding any valid hostname/IP.

R176.note: Build FAILS ('expr-eval' has no export 'evaluate'); as shipped, every request including legitimate calculator use would throw, silently breaking the endpoint while the write-up claims functionality is preserved.

R177.note: FromSql with FormattableString correctly parameterizes both values and removes the now-incorrect literal quotes; empty-term behavior (%% match) is unchanged, matching the stated contract.

R178.note: Sequelize named replacements (:startDate/:endDate) correctly parameterize both values, preserving the BETWEEN query semantics.

R179.note: StackExchange.Redis HashSet correctly closes the inline-protocol injection, but the constructor's dependency type changes from Socket to IDatabase, a disclosed breaking change to every existing caller.

R180.note: userId is threaded through but the store only checks `if (!userId)`, which is always true post-requireAuth, so any authenticated user still receives any project's export - the ownership check is a no-op; no other observable behavior is harmed.

R181.note: Routes retrieve() through self.get_object(), correctly restoring both the get_queryset() scoping and has_object_permission() check per the stated contract.

R182.note: Fixes both the off-by-one (>= instead of >) and the stale-capacity propagation (passes requestedCapacity instead of the constant), matching the stated contract exactly.

R183.note: Replaces raw SMTP command building with Jakarta Mail's Transport.send()/InternetAddress, eliminating the CRLF injection vector while preserving subject/body content; the cited CVE/version numbers are unverifiable but don't affect the code fix itself.

R184.note: Allowlist plus MIME check correctly closes the dangerous-extension bypass, but narrows accepted types from 'anything except exe/php/sh/bat' down to 8 specific extensions, rejecting previously-allowed types (e.g. zip, csv, xlsx) with no stated contract requiring that narrowing.

R185.note: Adds the POSIX -- end-of-options marker before filenames, exactly matching the stated contract of passing dash-led names through literally rather than rejecting or misinterpreting them.

R186.note: Removes the stray [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] override so the endpoint falls back to the app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter; no new restriction added.

R187.note: Switches to shell=False with an argument list, passing report_id/output_path as literal args to the .bat file with no other behavior change.
